# SQLite amalgamation

Contains `sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` from the official SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation download (`sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip`). The downloaded archive SHA-256 was `0A9C8E34352DAD46006AA82836D5383BFF9DC6BC9CE5A60553C05AA30E6AD1F9`.

SQLite is in the public domain. The upstream download page and amalgamation guide are <https://www.sqlite.org/download.html> and <https://www.sqlite.org/amalgamation.html>. The CMake target builds SQLite into the library and disables loadable extensions.
